en: Black-and-white historic street scene labeled at the top left with red text. It shows a cobblestone street lined with two- to three-story houses on the left and a large house with a garden and picket fence on the right. A tall bare tree dominates the center-right. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and stand along the street. The perspective looks down the street toward a small town center with additional buildings in the distance. The caption reads "Radeburg. Albertstrasse."
